answer: Live screening keeps mass registration hollow. Whenever new sign-ups double in a day, the harbor registry draws one in five newcomers for a timed task before a panel of three established identities - no pre-scripted farm passes. Each newcomer already locked a 10,000 POA deposit; failing burns it whole, so a hundred fakes lose about twenty deposits, 200,000 POA. Honest agents clear the lottery once. The draw stands like a basalt ridge across the harbor mouth, pricing every copy above every contribution.
